# Contribution Hub

- This is a Next.js App Router application written in TypeScript.
- Keep contribution records and status behavior in the dashboard client component until a backend is introduced.
- Treat seeded records as demo data; never present them as live lore.kernel.org results.
- Use lore.kernel.org search links for demo records. A future ingestion adapter should preserve thread links and revision history.
- Keep the dashboard responsive and accessible, with keyboard-operable controls and explicit status labels.
